description: This Java class is a builder for EffectedSubjects objects, allowing the fluent addition of granted and revoked authorization subjects, and constructing an EffectedSubjects instance.

classes.name: EffectedSubjectsBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class with a fluent API for constructing EffectedSubjects instances, managing sets of granted and revoked AuthorizationSubjects.

methods.name: EffectedSubjectsBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing empty sets for granted and revoked subjects.

methods.name: withGranted
methods.description: Adds a subject to the granted set if it is not in the revoked set.

methods.name: withRevoked
methods.description: Adds a subject to the revoked set and removes it from the granted set.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an EffectedSubjects instance based on the accumulated sets.
